title: Chernobyl Nuclear Disaster
description:
The **Chernobyl disaster** was a nuclear accident that occurred on April 26, 1986, at the No. 4 reactor in the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, near Pripyat, in Soviet Ukraine.

It is considered the worst nuclear disaster in history. The accident occurred during a late-night safety test which resulted in a massive explosion and fire that released large amounts of radioactive particles into the atmosphere.

The city of Pripyat was evacuated, and a 30-kilometer exclusion zone was established. The disaster had severe health and environmental consequences across Europe.
